title: The Heart of the Glacier

scene_door.narration: Behind the blue door the ice is clear as glass, and in the middle of it the Great River begins as a single bright drop. Two wisps of cold light are guarding it.

fight_wisps.narration: The wisps flare blue and turn toward you.

onVictory.narration: The wisps fade into the ice, and the ice begins to sing.

onDefeat.narration: The wisps drive you back toward the door.

scene_song.narration: The bright drop falls, and the river starts its long run south to the Exchange, singing all the way.

scene_pushed.narration: You tumble back through the door, but the drop has fallen anyway. The river will find its own way south.
